report.title: Explainable Rule-Based Architecture Health Report
report.lowCoverageExplanation: The majority of this repository's code uses languages or frameworks where AST dependency resolution is incomplete. Missing dependencies are not treated as evidence of clean architecture.
report.noFindings: No architectural rule violations were triggered. All evaluated structural rules passed successfully.
report.evaluationsHeading: Rule Evaluations & Mathematical Deductions ({{triggered}} Triggered, {{passed}} Passed)
report.noEvaluatedFindings: No findings from evaluated rules. Dependency rules remain unverified because AST coverage is insufficient.
report.noEvaluatedFindingsGeneral: No findings in the evaluated rules. See coverage and unverified rules below.

ARCH-001.title: Circular Dependency Violations (ADP)
ARCH-001.remediation: Extract shared contracts/interfaces into a lower-level module or apply Dependency Inversion to break mutual imports.

ARCH-002.title: Excessive Efferent Coupling (High Fan-Out)
ARCH-002.remediation: Decompose orchestrator modules into focused domain services or facade sub-packages to reduce direct fan-out.

ARCH-003.title: Stable Dependencies Principle (SDP) Inversion
ARCH-003.remediation: Invert the dependency using an abstract interface or move shared types into the stable core layer.

ARCH-004.title: Oversized Modules / God File Risk
ARCH-004.remediation: Split large modules along cohesive responsibility boundaries into smaller, testable modules.

ARCH-005.title: Isolated / Potentially Unreferenced Modules
ARCH-005.remediation: Verify whether isolated modules are dead code, dynamically loaded plugins, or standalone scripts, and remove unused files.

ARCH-006.title: Excessive Directory Hierarchy Depth
ARCH-006.remediation: Flatten deeply nested package directories to improve discoverability and shorten import paths.

SEC-001.title: Potential Secret or Sensitive File Exposure
SEC-001.remediation: Remove sensitive files from version control, rotate any exposed credentials immediately, and add patterns to .gitignore.

onboarding.title: RepoDNA Quick Guide
onboarding.step1Desc: Start with your local workspace, any public GitHub repository, or explore the preloaded demo architecture in one click.
onboarding.step2Desc: The summary strip displays your project's overall score, circular dependencies, and language coverage confidence.
onboarding.step3Desc: Zoom, pan, and select modules or package clusters. Edges show how files import each other with directional flow.
onboarding.step4Desc: Click any file or package to see its role, stability, and actionable engineering recommendations in the Inspector.

help.fanInDesc: Number of other modules that import or depend on this file. High Fan-In modules are core providers.
help.fanOutDesc: Number of other modules this file directly imports. High Fan-Out modules are orchestrators that depend on many parts.
help.instabilityDesc: Measures resilience to change. 0.00 is completely stable (depended upon, depends on nothing). 1.00 is volatile.
help.sccDesc: Groups of modules mutually reachable through dependency chains, detected using Tarjan's algorithm.
help.circularDesc: A mutual dependency loop between two or more modules (e.g. A → B → A) violating the Acyclic Dependencies Principle.
help.astCoverageDesc: Percentage of source code parsed with Tree-sitter abstract syntax trees for verified static dependency extraction.
help.confidenceDesc: A coverage-based assessment reflecting how completely imports and syntax could be resolved via Tree-sitter AST, not an empirical accuracy probability. Repositories with partial language support are honestly rated Low or Unverified.
